show.description: When India’s “Football God,” Kunal Varma, dies in a shocking crash, his soul resurfaces a decade later inside a humble stadium sweeper—just as his beloved East Delhi team is spiraling toward a lifetime ban. With a broken squad, a ruthless family takeover, and a world-class rival backed by rigged power, Kunal must reclaim the game—and the team’s fate—before everything is sold, silenced, and lost.
